caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a bottle-like, elongated flask oriented vertically with the neck at the top and the base at the bottom. The object is rendered as a line drawing on a plain, light-colored background. The flask has flat sides with slightly indented panels, and embossed text runs vertically along its length. The text on the left side of the flask reads "WORKS PHILADELPHIA," while the text on the right reads "ADAMS & JEFFERSON." The overall composition of the drawing is simple, with the flask positioned centrally on the page and no additional objects or artistic elements present. The image includes a small printed label at the bottom margin, identifying it as "Plate No. 3" with the description "End View of General Washington Whiskey Flask... Kensington Glass Works Phila. Pa."
title: Gen. Washington Flask
